concerns: Returning a raw Map<String, Object> in the controller and service can bypass strong compile-time type checks; consider using a dedicated DTO.
The query `UPPER(l.status) <> 'PENDING'` is used in LeadRepository; hardcoding status names inside queries can make it harder to maintain if status values change.

DeliverableController's updateDeliverable uses a read-then-save pattern to update status/lifecycle fields; consider using the atomically-guarded `updateStatusAtomically` method defined in DeliverableRepository.
UUID generation is hardcoded inside the REST controller; consider moving ID generation to a service layer or utilizing JPA entity lifecycle callbacks.
